dmn_experiences.title: Beer Tours of Lewes
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided beer tour of Lewes led by an Advanced Cicerone, taking in Harvey's Brewery and the town's craft breweries for tastings.
highlights: Led by an Advanced Cicerone and international beer judge
Visits Harvey's Brewery and the John Harvey pub
Tastings at craft breweries Beak and Abyss
Easy walking tour through historic Lewes
